==Description==
'''Overhaul v1.0''' was the twenty-fifth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 29th of October 2020. This update is a finalized release of the [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], introducing numerous drastic changes to the game.

Unlike with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was an official name for this update, that being the '''Overhaul Update'''. '''Overhaul v1.0''' has been retroactively applied to this update to keep in line with the numbering scheme with the other updates.
